scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
What do you wan te withz me? Be gone!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你想干什么？快滚开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
You have no more business with me, go away!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你跟我没什么好谈的，走开！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
E'llo mah frien, would I interesst tu with this rare mask? Its value I assure you is real mah frien. Tis manific!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
嘿，朋友，你对这个稀有的面具感兴趣吗？我向你保证，它的价值绝对真实，朋友。真是精美绝伦！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ack! Forgez it! I can do bettaz en elsez where!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啊！算了！我可以在别的地方卖得更好！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Wah? O ho ho ho, so you know thaz I steal dis from those savages no? Well I won'tz give it back. But I will for a pricez... wat you say?
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
哇？哦呵呵呵，原来你知道这东西是我从那些野猪那里偷来的，是吗？好吧，我不会还给你的。不过，如果你出个价的话...你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ahh a business man are you no?  Fine, how about...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
啊，原来你是生意人，是吗？好吧，那这样...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Hmmm... you drive a hard bargain, ok... my final offer...
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
嗯...你还价真狠，好吧...我的最终报价...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Are youz playin wit me? You don't have ze money!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
你在耍我吗？你没钱！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
O ho ho, it's a deal, then!
scripts.translation:
[缠头巾的盗贼]
哦呵呵，成交！
